## Registration eligibility

| Detail | Source statement |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Scope: Customer portal. |
| 2 | Registration requires all the following conditions. |
| 3 | The user provides a valid email address. |
| 4 | The user provides a password of at least 12 characters. |
| 5 | The user accepts the terms of service. |
| 6 | Missing any required condition prevents registration. |
| 7 | Invited company users do not need to provide a password; the other registration conditions still apply. |

## Registration activation

| Detail | Source statement |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Scope: Customer portal. |
| 2 | Registration activation requires either of the following confirmations. |
| 3 | The user follows the email confirmation link. |
| 4 | The user enters a confirmation code supplied by support. |
| 5 | Either confirmation is enough to satisfy this confirmation requirement; it does not guarantee successful activation. |

## Password reset

| Detail | Source statement |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Scope: Customer portal. |
| 2 | Password reset requires all the following conditions. |
| 3 | The account has a verified email address. |
| 4 | The account is active. |
| 5 | An inactive account cannot reset its password. |
